chunks: We have sent an Apostle to you as a witness against you, as We had sent an apostle to the Pharaoh.
ai.seo_question: Who is the witness sent against the people of Mecca in Surah Al-Muddaththir?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Muddaththir draws a parallel between the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) being sent to the Quraysh and the Prophet sent to Pharaoh. It emphasizes that the Prophet serves as a witness against his people on the Day of Judgment, just as the messenger to Pharaoh served as a witness against the Egyptians. Shia exegetes, such as Allamah Tabatabai, highlight this as a unique attribute of the Prophet, underscoring his role as a divine witness (shahid) who testifies to the truth received, thereby validating the message's authenticity before God.
